python -c "
import re
# Get the regex from semver
from semver import _REGEX
print('Regex:', _REGEX)
# Test it
pattern = re.compile(_REGEX)
test_cases = ['2.9.1', 'not a version', '2.9.1-beta', '2.9.1-beta.1']
for tc in test_cases:
    m = pattern.match(tc)
    print(f'{tc}: {bool(m)}')" 2>&1
